title: Sun and Weather Sort
intro: Sort what sunlight does, then get ready for the forecast.
note: This is a model of what you can test outside with a thermometer or your hand. Do the real warm-and-shade test too.
summary: Dark surfaces in full sun warm up more than light ones, and shade blocks sunlight so things stay cooler. A forecast tells us what to get ready for.

stages.prompt: In full sunlight, which things warm up MORE and which LESS? Compare each card with its partner: blacktop and sidewalk, black and white shirt, a bench in sun and in shade.

cards.label: Dark blacktop in the sun
cards.why: Dark surfaces take in more of the sunlight, so they get warmer.
cards.hint: is it a dark color or a light color?

cards.label: Black T-shirt in the sun
cards.why: Dark cloth takes in more sunlight than light cloth.
cards.hint: is it a dark color or a light color?

cards.label: A bench in full sun
cards.why: Sunlight lands right on it and warms it more than the same bench in shade.
cards.hint: is sunlight landing on this bench, or is a tree blocking it?

cards.label: Light-colored sidewalk
cards.why: Light colors take in less of the sunlight, so they stay cooler than dark ones.
cards.hint: is it a dark color or a light color?

cards.label: White T-shirt in the sun
cards.why: Light colors take in less sunlight than dark colors.
cards.hint: is it a dark color or a light color?

cards.label: The same bench under a tree
cards.why: The tree's shade blocks sunlight, so the bench is not warmed as much.
cards.hint: is sunlight landing on this bench, or is a tree blocking it?

stages.prompt: The forecast says it is coming. What do you get ready?

cards.label: Hat and sunscreen
cards.why: A hat and sunscreen keep too much sunlight off your skin.
cards.hint: what protects you from bright sun?

cards.label: Find a shady spot
cards.why: Shade blocks sunlight, so you stay cooler.

cards.label: Rain boots
cards.why: Rain boots keep your feet dry in puddles.
cards.hint: what keeps your feet dry in water?

cards.label: Umbrella
cards.why: An umbrella keeps rain off you.
cards.hint: what keeps falling water off you?

cards.label: Mittens and snow pants
cards.why: Warm snow clothes keep you warm in snow.
cards.hint: what keeps you warm in the cold?

cards.label: Sled
cards.why: A sled is for sliding on snow.
cards.hint: what do you play on in snow?

cards.label: Go inside, away from windows
cards.why: Inside a building is the safe place in a thunderstorm.
cards.hint: where is the safe place when there is lightning?

cards.label: Wait inside 30 minutes after the last thunder
cards.why: Lightning can still strike after the storm seems to be over, so wait inside until 30 minutes after the last thunder.
cards.hint: when is it safe to go back out?
